parts.text: The shape and dimensions of the skyscrapers depend entirely on the necessity of obtaining the maximum income per square foot of ground, and of offering to the tenants offices and apartments that please them . the necessity of doing sth. 做某事的必要性 offer sth. to sb. 给某人提供某事 This caused the construction of gigantic buildings where too large masses of human beings are crowded together . mass n. throng; a large crowd 一大群人 Civilized men like such a way of living. a way of living 一种生活方式 While they enjoy the comfort and banal luxury of their dwelling, they do not realize that they are deprived of the necessities of life . While / Although / Though 尽管（引导让步状语从句） dwelling 住宅（优雅表达） be deprived of ... 被剥夺了... the necessities of life：the clean atmosphere, the closeness to nature, the intimacy of people, etc. But city dwellers are deprived of all these valuable things in the concrete jungle. The modern city consists of monstrous edifices and of dark, narrow streets full of petrol fumes and toxic gases, torn by the noise of the taxicabs, lorries and buses, and thronged ceaselessly by great crowds. consist of 由...组成 (强调静态构成，不能用于被动语态) pollutants / problems 污染/问题 torn by 被...撕裂/打破 Obviously, it has not been planned for the good of its inhabitants. 总结句（concluding sentence） for the good of... 为了...的利益
The report stresses the necessity of eating plenty of fresh fruit and vegetables. 名词做中心词更庄严、正式
The report stresses that it is necessary to eat plenty of fresh fruit and vegetables. 中式表达

headers: out of necessity 出于必要
be a necessity 必须要… (n.)
be necessary 必要的 (adj.)
be a must 必须要做/有的事 (n.)
compulsory （因法律或规则而）必须做的，强制的
rows: Women increasingly went out to work, usually out of economic necessity. 越来越多的女性外出工作，通常是出于经济上的必要。
For most people, a good guide book is a necessity when traveling. 对于大多数人来说，一本好的导游书在旅行时是必需品。
It is necessary to reserve tickets in advance during peak season. 在旺季提前预订门票是必要的。
Visiting the Great Wall is a must for anyone traveling to Beijing. 对于任何去北京旅游的人来说，参观长城是必须要做的事情。
a compulsory course 必修课 an optional / elective course 选修课 ... while our own compulsory school attendance became law in Germany in 1642 ,...

headers: a mass/throng of people 一大群人/人群
mass education 群众教育；普及教育
mass media 大众传媒
weapons of mass destruction 大规模杀伤性武器
problems of mass unemployment 大规模失业问题
rows: There was a mass/throng of people gathered outside the concert hall. 音乐厅外面聚集着一大群人。
The government invested heavily in promoting mass education across the country. 政府投入巨资在全国推广普及教育。
The campaign relied heavily on the mass media to spread its message. 这项运动严重依赖大众传媒来传播其信息。
The treaty was signed to reduce the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction. 签署该条约是为了减少大规模杀伤性武器的扩散。
The recession led to serious problems of mass unemployment in the industrial sector. 经济衰退导致工业部门出现了严重的大规模失业问题。

parts.text: Thankfulness is a way of living more fully. 感恩是让生活更充实的一种方式。
A healthy diet is part of a healthy way of living.
Abundance is a life style, a way of living your life. 富足是一种生活方式。
While she is a likable girl, she can be extremely difficult to work with.
While the quality of legal journalism varies greatly, there is an undue reliance amongst many journalists on interpretations supplied to them by lawyers. 考研英语
While comment and reaction from lawyers may enhance stories, it is preferable for journalists to rely on their own notions of significance and make their own judgments.
While Washington and Jefferson privately expressed distaste for slavery, they also understood that it was part of the political and economic bedrock of the country they helped to create.

headers: while / whereas 而（轻微转折）放句中，与前半句对比
rows: He must be over 60, while his wife looks about 30.而他的妻子看起来大约30岁 One man stayed at the wheel while two others with black stockings over their faces jumped out and smashed the window of the shop with iron bars.

rows: The rock sample is made up of quartz, mica, and feldspar. 这块岩石样本由石英、云母和长石组成。
The Earth's atmosphere is composed of several layers of gases. 地球的大气层由几层气体构成。
The district comprises six towns and numerous small villages. 该地区包括六个城镇和许多小村庄。
Students comprise a large percentage of the city's population. 学生构成了该城市人口的很大一部分。
Women make up sixty percent of the workforce in this industry. 女性组成了该行业百分之六十的劳动力。
Several independent nations compose the federation. 几个独立的国家组成了这个联邦。
The three volumes constitute the complete works of the poet. 这三卷构成了这位诗人的完整作品集。

headers: for the sake of … 为了…的原因/目的
for the benefit of … 为了…的益处
in the interest of … 为了…的利益
on behalf of … 代表…
rows: They decided to compromise for the sake of peace and unity. 他们决定妥协，以求和平与团结。
The funds were raised for the benefit of local charities. 这些资金是为当地慈善机构的利益筹集的。
The details were kept secret in the interest of national security. 为了国家安全，这些细节被保密了。
The lawyer spoke on behalf of his client during the court hearing. 律师在庭审中代表他的客户发言。
